newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 3.165 billion yuan from 2.27 billion yuan on last Thursday with the 20-day contract the most actively traded.
Figures for last Friday were not available.
Trading was active on Monday due to increased trading by securities houses and foreign banks through the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traders said.
Traders said recent officially-issued economic data showed China's inflation rate was falling. This could lead to gradual falls of the interbank rates, they said.
